title: MCP tool results with 'outputSchema' fail with error -32600

triage_metadata.reasoning: No source files were pruned; all PR modifications directly address the reported issue.

summary.problem: MCP tool calls fail with protocol error 'MCP error -32600: Tool [name] has an output schema but did not return structured content' when an MCP server returns schema-backed results inside the 'content' field rather than 'structuredContent'.
summary.root_cause: The CLI previously only wrapped stdio transports using XcodeMcpBridgeFixTransport for 'xcrun mcpbridge'. When other MCP servers (or HTTP/SSE transports) returned JSON payloads in 'content' without 'structuredContent', outputSchema validation failed in the MCP SDK.
summary.context: The fix refactors XcodeMcpBridgeFixTransport into McpComplianceTransport and applies it to all MCP connection types (Stdio, SSE, HTTP) in mcp-client.ts.

steps: Rename packages/core/src/tools/xcode-mcp-fix-transport.ts to packages/core/src/tools/mcp-compliance-transport.ts and rename class XcodeMcpBridgeFixTransport to McpComplianceTransport.
In McpComplianceTransport, mark property 'readonly transport: Transport' to allow unwrapping the underlying transport.
In packages/core/src/tools/mcp-client.ts, update transport imports from XcodeMcpBridgeFixTransport to McpComplianceTransport.
In createTransportWithOAuth in mcp-client.ts, wrap the created URL transport with new McpComplianceTransport(...).
In createTransport in mcp-client.ts, wrap all created URL transports (SSE and HTTP) and StdioClientTransport instances unconditionally with new McpComplianceTransport(...).

In createTransport debug mode, unwrap transport by checking 'transport instanceof McpComplianceTransport ? transport.transport : transport' to attach debug listeners to the underlying StdioClientTransport stderr.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When an MCP server returns JSON stringified output in the 'content' text array without 'structuredContent', McpComplianceTransport parses the JSON and populates 'structuredContent', allowing schema validation to pass.
verification_steps: Verify non-compliant tool results with JSON in content are enriched with structuredContent.
Verify already compliant responses with structuredContent, plain text non-JSON content, empty content, and error responses are preserved without modification.
Run client tests: npm test -w @google/gemini-cli-core -- src/tools/mcp-client.test.ts
